meaning.en: A mischievous, troublesome, or unruly person.
meaning.vi: Một người tinh quái, rắc rối, hay ngỗ ngược.

meaning.en: (informal) A person fond of deviltry; mischievous troublemaker; rascal.
meaning.vi: (không chính thức) Một người thích ma quỷ; kẻ phá rối tinh quái; thô lỗ.

meaning.en: An unruly, rowdy or mischievous person.
meaning.vi: Một người ngỗ ngược, om sòm hoặc nghịch ngợm.

meaning_vi: người khó chịu; người hay quấy rầy

sentences.vi: Phạm vi Hellion hoàn nguyên từ 6 thành 5.

sentences.en: This damage will be lethal if Caldera Hellion hasn't devoured any creatures and its toughness hasn't been increased by any other means.

sentences.en: If someone casts your Hellion card and the opponent doesn't sit up and take notice, you're doing something wrong.

sentences.en: The Hellion is the beating heart of the volcano, the surging force of nature's bloody wrath.

sentences.en: In doing so, they have created a one-of-a-kind hellion - if the car really does exist.

sentences.en: Caldera Hellion will deal 3 damage to itself (as well as to each other creature) when its comes-into-play ability resolves.

sentences.en: I can say to the child, there is bad person on this world[sentencedict .com], but hellion is very few.
